notes.title: New Patch Available! Fixes & Improvements #1
notes.notes:
Ahoy Fellow Pirates!

[b]You can now access new build of Ruiga Pirates (v0.75.3).[/b]

To discuss please join the official [url=https://discord.gg/zfX8Ewqv2X]Discord![/url]

Full changelog:
[list]
[*] Mouse scroll problems on pre-play page fixed.
[*] Opening Scene bug fixed.
[*] Bugged Achievements fixed
[*] Frigate, Fast Galleon and War Galleon deleted.
[*] Game speed increased and enemy stats balanced.
[*] Wind negative effects deleted.
[*] Wind feature balanced.
[*] Wind VFX changed.
[*] Indicators improved.
[*] Localization improved.
[/list]

Thank you for keep fighting against pirates!

Valentware Team

notes.title: Update Time! v0.24.4 Demo Out!
notes.notes:
[b]Ahoy, Pirates! Set Sail with the Latest Update![/b]

Exciting news awaits you on the high seas - Ruiga Pirates has just released a new update, packed with enhancements to elevate your piracy experience. Here's the update list:

[list]
[*] Quests of Island: Island ahead! And ready for plunder, raze or maybe save it. Who knows?
[*] Shiny Chest: If you feel lucky enough, you can find chests now! 
[*] New Seas a Shore: Totally new and much more different sea texture added with tasty shaders.
[*] Plunder-Ready Weaponry: Values for your trusty weapons have been fine-tuned, providing a fairer chance for victory in every skirmish.
[*] New Weapons for the Arsenal: Discover exciting new additions to your pirate arsenal! Unleash fresh tactics on your adversaries.
[*] Gameplay Enhancements: We've fine-tuned the overall gameplay, making each seafaring adventure more thrilling and immersive.
[*] Player-Driven Improvements: Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've implemented a series of improvements to make the game even more pirate-tastic. Your voice matters!
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/zfX8Ewqv2X] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719367/8aafbd52b7e09f4a8278a4b501298e7fc8a85999.png[/img] [/url]

notes.title: Join Discord and Meet with Crewbies!
notes.notes:
🏴‍☠️ Ahoy, Landlubbers! Join the Ruiga Pirates Crew! 🏴‍☠️

Avast, me hearties! Gather 'round and hear ye a tale of high seas and treacherous adventures. We be excited to announce the launch of "Ruiga Pirates" on Steam – a swashbucklin' game that'll shiver yer timbers!

What be "Ruiga Pirates"?
"Ruiga Pirates" be an epic pirate-themed game that'll take ye on a wild journey across the Seven Seas. Brace yerself for battles, hidden treasures, and the thrill of the pirate's life. Will ye rise to be a legendary captain or end up in Davy Jones' locker?

Why Join Our Crew?
🌊 Exclusive Updates: Be the first to know about the latest developments, updates, and additions to the game.
🏴‍☠️ Pirate Community: Join a lively crew of like-minded scallywags who share a passion for piracy and adventure.
🎮 Gameplay Sneak Peeks: Get a glimpse of the action with exclusive gameplay previews and behind-the-scenes content.
